title: Snap-on Cable Sleeve
description: A short, split-tube circuit marker that flexes open and snaps sideways onto a 2.5 mm² single-core electrical cable, with a recessed landscape code repeated around the sleeve.

assets.label: Landscape codes
assets.alt: Orange split-tube cable markers with recessed landscape codes L1P2 and L2P1
assets.caption: Updated concept — L1P2 and L2P1 shown as recessed landscape identification codes repeated around separate sleeves.

assets.label: Earlier concept
assets.alt: Orange split-tube cable marker shown upright and installed on a brown electrical cable
assets.caption: Concept only — dimensions will be tuned with physical fit tests before the first printable model.
